description.value:
As a bonus action, you can enter a razor-sharp focus for up to a minute, maintaining it as though concentrating on a power. While focused, each successful Sneak Attack adds two more Sneak Attack dice to your pool, stacking with each hit, dice that vanish the moment your focus ends, whether from broken concentration or the minute running out.

The first time you use this feature between long rests, there's no cost. Using it again before a long rest gives you one level of exhaustion each additional time.
